rd_frontier: Higher-voltage, MCS-compatible modular powertrains for HDVs
expected_evolution_2031_2036: MCS moves from early-adopter option to the default long-haul charging interface; R&D shifts to higher-voltage, modular powertrains sized per mission.
driver: HDV CO2 targets of -45% (2030) and -65% (2035) force battery-electric long-haul.
barrier: Grid connection capacity and corridor charger roll-out lag vehicle availability.
signpost: MCS share of public HDV chargers; award of the 2027 D5-05 projects.

rd_frontier: Operator-independent, multi-OEM SOH/RUL with quantified uncertainty, feeding battery-passport dynamic data
expected_evolution_2031_2036: SOH analytics become an expected fleet service and feed battery-passport dynamic data; value moves to OEM-independent, uncertainty-quantified remaining-life estimates for warranty and second-life.
driver: Battery passport (Feb 2027) and 8-year battery warranties in 15-year bus lives.
barrier: Operators often lack access to raw battery data from the OEM BMS.
signpost: Battery-passport dynamic-data rules; InnoBMS vehicle demo results (mid-2027).

rd_frontier: Twins for mixed commercial fleets across OEMs
expected_evolution_2031_2036: Vehicle-specific twins linked to operating data across the lifecycle become the backbone for energy, health and lifecycle services.
driver: Software-defined vehicles make per-vehicle configuration and data available.
barrier: No common data model across OEMs; data ownership and cost of keeping twins current.
signpost: TWIN-LOOP validated use cases (end 2027); Catena-X twin standards.

rd_frontier: Credibility toolkits for bus/coach ADAS and automated shuttles
expected_evolution_2031_2036: Credibility-assessed simulation becomes routine evidence for selected approval tests, always alongside physical tests.
driver: UN R171 already allows virtual testing with a mandatory credibility assessment; scenario counts grow faster than test-track capacity.
barrier: Approval authorities need validated models; acceptance varies by regulation and technical service.
signpost: Adopted R152 virtual-testing text; first public type approval citing virtual evidence.

rd_frontier: Driverless, remotely supervised operation in mixed public urban traffic
expected_evolution_2031_2036: Driverless, remotely supervised shuttles move from closed sites (airports) to selected public corridors.
driver: Operator cost and driver shortages in public transport; Turin positioning as an EU test city.
barrier: Low commercial speeds (SHOW average 10.6 km/h), liability and remote-supervision rules.
signpost: First EU public-road permit without onboard operator; outcome of Turin's EU testbed bid.

rd_frontier: Passports for non-battery EV components (inverters, motors, battery thermal systems) linked to measured operational loads and LCA to drive circular decisions
expected_evolution_2031_2036: Passports extend from batteries to other high-value EV components and start driving repair, remanufacture and recycling decisions.
driver: Battery passport mandatory 18 Feb 2027; due diligence from 18 Aug 2027; Horizon 2027 call D5-03.
barrier: Component-level data access, cost of tracing, and unclear business case for reuse.

rd_frontier: Surrogates credible enough to contribute to validation or homologation evidence
expected_evolution_2031_2036: AI surrogates move from fast design exploration to trusted parts of engineering workflows, with quantified error and out-of-distribution checks.
driver: Commercial tools (May 2026) report around 1000x faster exploration than full CFD.
barrier: Trust: surrogate error outside the training domain; no framework accepts surrogates as validation evidence.
signpost: Adoption by BLUE's clients; credibility frameworks extended to ML models.

rd_frontier: Hydrogen hybrid minibus with Level 3 automation (B4IA)
expected_evolution_2031_2036: Hydrogen buses settle into niches (long routes, depots with hydrogen supply) while battery-electric dominates urban fleets.
driver: Hydrogen counts as zero-emission under Reg. 2024/1610; 100% zero-emission new urban buses by 2035.
barrier: Hydrogen fuel cost and refuelling infrastructure versus falling battery costs.
signpost: Hydrogen price per kg at bus depots; fleet orders (e.g. Bologna 127 planned).
